pins.head: A SEAT THAT STORES
pins.title: Small Apartment Organization: A Window Bench With Baskets Below
pins.desc: Small apartment organization works best when one piece does two jobs. A slim bench under the window gives you a seat, and the open shelf below holds a row of lidded woven baskets, so throws and small things go out of sight without a closed cabinet. Keep the top light with one folded blanket and a couple of cushions, and measure the shelf height before you buy baskets. Contains affiliate links. #SmallApartment #StorageBench #SmallSpaceLiving
pins.alt: A light oak bench under a window with a folded cream knit blanket and cream and sage linen cushions on top, three lidded woven baskets on the shelf below, a potted olive tree beside it, sheer curtains, a light oak floor and a pale rug.

pins.head: CLEAR COUNTER, BUSY WALL
pins.title: Vertical Storage: Move Jars and Tools Up the Kitchen Wall
pins.desc: Vertical storage frees a small counter by moving everyday things onto the wall. A wire grid with S-hooks holds the spoon, whisk and a small basket you reach for most, and floating shelves above take clear jars of pasta, rice and beans plus a stack of bowls. Keep the heaviest items on the lower shelf and check what your wall and lease allow before you mount anything. Contains affiliate links. #VerticalStorage #SmallKitchen #KitchenOrganization
pins.alt: A white kitchen wall with the edge of a floating oak shelf above a black wire grid holding a wooden spoon, a whisk and a woven basket on hooks, a butcher-block counter with a potted herb and a window to the right.

pins.head: UV OR EPOXY? ASK THE MOLD
pins.title: Resin Art for Beginners: UV Resin or Epoxy Resin for Your Project
pins.desc: Resin art for beginners gets easier when you choose the resin by the project, not the other way around. A shallow clear jewelry accent suits a quick UV cure under a small lamp, while a mold with deep or hidden areas, or a batch of coasters, usually calls for mixed epoxy. Check that light can reach every part of the piece before buying a lamp, and follow your product's own instructions. Contains affiliate links. #UVResin #EpoxyResin #ResinCrafts
pins.alt: A grey linen-covered table with a small white UV lamp and a gold pendant bezel on the left, and on the right a round clear silicone mold, two small clear measuring cups, two dropper bottles and two wooden stir sticks.

pins.head: ARRANGE IT DRY FIRST
pins.title: Epoxy Resin Tips: Put Dried Flowers in Resin Without Crowding Them
pins.desc: Epoxy resin tips for dried flowers start before you mix anything. Use flowers that are fully dried, lay the whole design out in the empty mold with tweezers, and leave space between each stem and petal so the resin can surround it. Test the exact flowers and resin together on a small piece first, since moisture and thickness both change the result. Contains affiliate links. #DriedFlowerResin #ResinArt #PressedFlowers
pins.alt: A round clear silicone mold on a walnut table holding a lavender sprig, three small white daisies and a fern leaf, with metal tweezers beside it, a white dish of pink and yellow dried petals and a sheet of brown parchment paper with more petals.

pins.head: START AT AN OUTER CORNER
pins.title: Cricut Vinyl Tips: How to Weed Vinyl Without Tearing Small Pieces
pins.desc: Cricut vinyl tips for weeding come down to light and order. Put a lamp beside the sheet so every cut line shows, start lifting the waste from a predictable outer corner, and use a weeding hook on the small enclosed parts instead of pulling them with the big piece. Keep removed scraps in a dish away from the design, and check the whole sheet before you add transfer tape. Contains affiliate links. #VinylWeeding #CricutTips #VinylCrafts
pins.alt: A black vinyl sheet with a cut white leaf-and-vine pattern on a pale blue cutting mat, a curled strip of removed black vinyl beside it and a metal weeding hook, on a white desk.

pins.head: HIDE THE BED BEHIND BOOKS
pins.sub: A Low Shelf as a Divider
pins.title: Studio Apartment Layout: A Low Bookcase Between Bed and Sofa
pins.desc: Studio apartment layout ideas often start with one low divider. An open bookcase set across the room screens the bed from the sofa without blocking the window light, and both sides can use its shelves. Put a round rug and a small table in front to mark the living area, and tuck a slim desk under the window. Measure the walkway on both sides of the shelf first. Contains affiliate links. #StudioApartment #SmallSpaceLayout #RoomDivider
pins.alt: A bright studio apartment with a bed and rust throw behind a low white open bookcase holding books, a vase and small plants, an olive green two-seat sofa, a round wool rug with a round wooden table, and a slim oak desk with a chair under the window.
